description.value: Friesen's Countrytyme Gardens is a farm-to-table breakfast and lunch institution that has served the Coldstream community since 1994, nestled in a picturesque outdoor garden setting on Kalamalka Lake Road and surrounded by local farms including their own. The menu spans house-baked breads (sourdough, rye, gluten-free buckwheat), an extensive pastry selection, eggs benedicts, and specialty espresso drinks — nearly everything made in-house. The welcoming outdoor patio and rural Okanagan setting make it a natural and rewarding stop for cyclists riding through the North Okanagan.

address.value: 9172 Kalamalka Lake Rd, Coldstream BC V1B 3C4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The restaurant's website at friesenscountrytyme.com is active and richly detailed, confirming the phone number and supplying the full address absent from OSM. The bakery subpage explicitly states goods can be enjoyed 'at the restaurant or take to go', confirming takeout; the main menu lists a Veggie Benny and the bakery lists Gluten Free Buckwheat bread, confirming vegetarian and GF options. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Friesen's Country Tyme Garden' (singular, two words) while the website consistently uses 'Friesen's Countrytyme Gardens' (plural, one word). OSM name appears misspelled or outdated.

The website contains an internal inconsistency in stated operating days between the body text and the footer/contact page. OSM operating hours also appear inconsistent with the website. Recommend a direct call to verify current schedule before publishing.
Address was absent from OSM; the value used here is taken from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating farm-to-table eatery with takeout, house-baked goods, and dietary options on Kalamalka Lake Road — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the Coldstream area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a Veggie Benny (vegetarian eggs benedict); bakery menu lists Gluten Free Buckwheat bread as a house-baked option
